Reach exact Running within the existing target deadline, retain Workload type vm and exact provider, have no DNS record, and expose one live status VM and one live database row with the same nonempty cloud ID and valid SSH coordinates.

Arm cleanup before creation, bind original credentials and every provisioning attempt/placement, and retain status identities and partial observations. Write a workspace marker, remove the workload container, and obtain a different nonempty Running container ID with the unchanged marker within 300 seconds.

After repair, repeat the complete runtime and environment/secret assertions and provider Running hook, retain exact Running and the original native VM in status and database, and require exactly one live row. Read current database SSH fields again.
